title: New Jersey security deposit cap
requirement: An owner or lessee may not require more than 1 1/2 times 1 month's rent as a security deposit. Any additional security deposit collected annually may not exceed 10 percent of the current security deposit.
key_value: 1 1/2 times 1 month's rent; additional annual deposit max 10% of current deposit
coverage_conditions: Real property used for dwelling purposes rented under a contract, lease or agreement.

coverage_quotes: real property used for dwelling purposes

quoted_span: An owner or lessee may not require more than a sum equal to 1 1/2 times 1 month's rental according to the terms of contract, lease, or agreement as a security for the use or rental of real property used for dwelling purposes.
